Structured goes from 0.533±0.178 intact to 0.478 with the wrong BC and 0.526 with BC zeroed; naive goes from 0.544 to 0.512 and 0.583. The paper itself calls this 'non-monotonic'. In the code the Neumann one-hot column is never active in training, so its weights stay at their random initialization. Held-out accuracy therefore does not degrade toward the baseline under ablation.

conditioning_attribution.non_degenerate.reason: The seen-axis IC ablation shows the IC input is used, and the latent is not constant: mean per-dimension std is 0.33 for structured vs 0.14 for naive. That statistic only measures dispersion across specifications that differ in coefficient, IC and BC. It does not show that the latent separates ICs or BCs, and it was computed on bcconv seeds 0/1 at coefficient/IC combinations those models never trained on. Figure 2 PCA-projects each BC group separately after centering it (analyze.py:152-156), so it cannot show separation between groups, and the plotted markers overlap. A read-only calculation on the saved latents finds the structured arm's within-BC spread (about 2.9–3.1) larger than its between-BC centroid distances (about 1.0–3.0). The direct check that the latent distinguishes ICs/BCs is therefore qualitative and unsupported.

contract.environment_integrity.pde_defin.reason: Retained: the PDE residual (β u_x − ν u_xx − ρu(1−u) + u_t), the domain (x∈[0,2π), t∈[0,1], 256×100), the metrics (rel-L2 and the reference's mean-absolute 'L2_absolute_error'), and new ICs passed as arguments to a replicated function(). The authored IMEX solver is validated. Not retained: the periodic reference construction. reference_solution() uses a Strang-split spectral_evolution instead of the held-fixed Lie-split reaction_diffusion_discrete_solution (reaction then diffusion). The replicated Lie version exists in spec_data.py but is unused. The task also requires a convergence spot-check for a held-out IC materially sharper than the trained zoo on operator-split RD. gauss_pi_8 (σ=π/8, vs the sharpest trained σ=π/4) was evaluated without that check. The size of the Strang-vs-Lie difference is not quantified in the submission.

contract.reference_solution_validity.new.reason: The non-periodic Dirichlet/Neumann IMEX references are validated: they converge under refinement and agree with the spectral reference on the periodic overlap. The periodic references used for all core numbers come from a modified Strang construction rather than the unchanged one. That construction was refinement-checked at a few settings but never compared with the unchanged Lie-split reference. The required convergence spot-check for the sharper held-out IC gauss_pi_8 on operator-split RD was not performed, although generalization was measured there; validate_references.py checks only trained ICs and 6+sin.

contract.experiment_completeness.all_exp.reason: The headline experiments have logs: baseline, naive, quantile, spectral and hybrid arms, 80k runs, BC runs, ablations, error-vs-distance, latent dispersion and reference validation. Some described work has no log. (i) The paper says the Fisher blow-up for sign-changing ICs was 'verified numerically', and the plan cites logs/reference_validation.json for it, but no such record exists. (ii) The cosine LR is described as 'selected on seen-specification validation', but no selection run or validation split is logged. (iii) PDE-type breadth is said to be 'documented in the attempts log', but no record exists. Also, the script that produced bcconv seeds 0/1 (a 2×2 split with 'final_loss'-format eval files) is not in the submitted code.
evidence: proposal/logs/reference_validation.json (19 checks, none on sign-changing ICs)

contract.effort_evidence.attempts_log_wh.reason: The paper presents PDE-type breadth as incomplete work ('scoped but not completed and is documented in the attempts log'). attempts_log.md contains no entry for it, so zero attempts are documented. The IC-axis negative is backed by multiple documented attempts (four encodings at 40k and 80k), but the claimed PDE-breadth item does not meet the requirement of at least two documented attempts.

evidence_completeness.quantitative_sourc.reason: Every value in Tables 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6 matches identifiable log entries. Sources: aggregated_results.json for the core 40k/80k/hybrid, baseline and BC 80k groups; reference_validation.json; ic_ablation.json and bc_ablation_quant.json; error_vs_distance_all.json. The same holds for the latent std of 0.33 vs 0.14, the parameter counts, the '>3×' spread and the 19-check count. The logs carry configs and seeds, so the claims can be evaluated. Small text mismatches have identifiable sources and fall under integrity: '0.072–0.097' against logged 0.072–0.086 (Table 2 arms) or 0.105, and '5–13×' against a per-seed maximum of 11.6×.

evidence_completeness.required_reporting.reason: Coverage gaps against the task and the declared protocol: (1) Completed and logged BC experiments are not reported: bc100 (3 seeds, 100k), where naive beats structured on held-out Neumann (0.366 vs 0.407) and on unseen coefficients (0.367 vs 0.412), and bc (2 seeds, 40k). (2) The reported BC '3 seeds' include two seeds from an undeclared 2×2 configuration, so the declared 9×4 BC split has a single seed. The BC coefficient and IC split is not stated in the paper. (3) The required per-coefficient non-regression check is not reported, only means, and the quantile arm fails it at 5/25 coefficients. Non-regression of the BC model is not reported. (4) No held-out-IC conditioning-removed ablation is reported. (5) Planned analyses are not reported: E3 latent-vs-specification distance, E4 amplitude/frequency sweep, and K selection. (6) The error-vs-specification curve is single-seed without uncertainty. (7) The attempts for the claimed PDE-breadth item are missing.

bc_extension_attempted.reason: The submission trains BC-conditioned models on {periodic, Dirichlet}, evaluates them on held-out Neumann against the raw-input control, and authors and validates an IMEX non-periodic reference solver. The paper reports this as its headline positive result.

boundary_analysis_attempted.reason: The paper sweeps the IC offset beyond the trained range until the structured encoder fails, analyzes the failure regimes, and asserts that the spectral failure is 'not under-training' based on runs with doubled epochs. It explicitly declines to claim a fundamental boundary.

partial_work_claimed.reason: The paper reports an honest-negative IC axis, a BC axis it calls only a 'trend', and PDE-type breadth that was 'scoped but not completed and is documented in the attempts log'. attempts_log.md documents unresolved work.

pde_breadth_attempted.reason: No multi-PDE-family model was trained or evaluated. run_breadth.py and plan item E6 exist, but no runs or logs do. The paper explicitly says it does not claim multi-family breadth and only scoped it.
